pdf.js JBIG2 physical test fixture
=================================
Upstream:    https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
Version:     v6.0.227
Commit:      241dbabbf1c6a5024dc4e573356977878317e04f
Source file: test/pdfs/jbig2_symbol_offset.pdf
Source URL:  https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/archive/refs/tags/v6.0.227.tar.gz
Archive SHA-256: d2894d77c111b603c05a673cfb39ca71d70909d77f0a6377097c496ce98dcc60
File SHA-256:    305b71c67829ef0bb8bddab9fa3ee763dcecd173f5fd996740d17212888fa97d
License:     Apache-2.0 (the upstream repository LICENSE)

The one-page fixture contains an actual `/JBIG2Decode` image and no useful
text layer. The in-browser read_doc/OCR test must rasterize this image through
the packaged pdf.js decoder before its deterministic recognizer can inspect
the pixels. Modification: none.
